purpose: Proves the verifier-only tool scope: verification tools (screenshot capture / page eval) are reserved for the verifier role. If the MAIN build agent invokes a verifier-only tool, the tool-scope oracle fails it.
required_evidence: tool_call.name in the verifier-only set (e.g. verify_web_app screenshot, page eval)
caller role of the tool_call (main_agent vs verifier)
tool registry scope tag for the tool
rationale: verify_web_app (screenshot + page eval) is scope-tagged verifier_only so that verification evidence is produced by an independent verifier, not self-attested by the builder. The main agent called it directly, violating verifier-only tool scope, so the oracle returns fail.
